The track pants of your dreams. Designed to easily layer and breathe over running gear, these technical pants are made to move with you—before, after, and all race weekend long. Stash unneeded clothing through the exposed section of waistband elastic for on-the-fly storage. Sleek and functional.

We love it for: race weekend

  • PacerWeaveTM body: 91% recycled polyester & 9% spandex
    • Wicking, lightweight & cling-free
  • Collar, cuffs & hem: 82% polyester, 15% cotton & 3% spandex
  • rabbitDRY piping & pocket lining: 88% polyester & 12% Spandex
  • Semi-relaxed fit
  • External drawstring
  • Exposed waistband elastic on right hip
  • Pockets:
    • 2 front zipper pockets
    • 1 back right zipper pocket
  • Reflective details
  • Concealed ankle zippers
  • 28” inseam
  • Machine wash cold, tumble dry, don't bleach
  • Designed in California, made abroad

We are happy to accept returns or exchanges of any unworn, regularly priced items for up to 30 days after purchase.

Most orders are shipped within 3-4 business days; orders over $125 ship for free within the U.S. International shipping is available for most countries.
